# Ultrafuzz Threat-Model & ARI Refresh — Issue #527 Selected Aggregate (anthropic lane, v2 canonical recompute)

**Read-only refresh.** Re-assessment of the selected aggregate at final commit `950c0c44…` against baseline `a634d948…`, using Threat-Model Skill v8 (`d4846045…`) and ARI v1.1 (`847f5e30…`). Model provenance: intended `claude-fable-5`, served by approved direct fallback `claude-opus-4-8` (effort max) because Fable was unavailable. Code is the authority; nothing was credited from the prior report, manifest, commit messages, branch names, or test names alone. Every number below was recomputed directly from the JSON control arrays with the ARI reference formula.

**Implemented scope verified from code:** R-01, R-02, R-03, R-04, R-05, R-07, R-10, R-11, R-15, R-16, R-18, R-25, R-28. Everything else in the historical manifest is deferred and scored exactly as the code warrants — not credited.

## Headline scores (recomputed, canonical)

| state | ARI | grade | band | RM | RC | gate cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| old | 28.39 | C | C | 7.95 | 28 | C |
| pivot | 39.17 | C | C | 11.36 | 29 | C |
| final | 18.86 | C | B | 5.47 | 29 | C |

- OLD reproduces this lane's pinned published baseline **exactly**: ARI 28.392857142857142, RM 7.95, RC 28, Grade C (capped at C by T1, a High with gap 0.50 ≥ 0.50).
- PIVOT (refreshed 11-threat set on baseline code): ARI **39.17**, RM 11.36, RC 29 — Grade C.
- FINAL (same threat shapes on final code): ARI **18.86**, RM 5.47, RC 29 — numeric band **B**, but **Grade C**, held there by the severity gate on T1.

## Delta decomposition

ΔARI(old→final) = **−9.53** = Δ_scope (**+10.78**) + Δ_controls (**−20.31**).
- **Δ_scope = +10.78** — modeled harder/riskier at baseline: added T11 (pricing-fetch SSRF, gap 0.50), rescored T4 to 1.00 (no governance control exists in baseline code) and broadened/rescored T2 to 0.50 (open controller-source-execution facet).
- **Δ_controls = −20.31** — code-verified remediation gains on T2 (0.50→0.10 via R-01), T3 (0.50→0.04 via R-02/R-05), T4 (1.00→0.20 via R-04), T7 (0.50→0.35 via R-10/R-11), T9 (0.20→0.04 via R-15/R-16), and T11 (0.50→0.20 via R-16).

**Central finding:** the remediation nearly halves ARI (39→19) and moves the numeric band into B, yet the letter grade **stays C**. The ARI High-severity gate caps the grade at C because T1 (credentialed YOLO execution) is a High that retains gap **0.50** — the four accepted residuals D-01…D-04 were deliberately left in place, so the grade-capping threat is unchanged by design. Substantial hardening that cannot move the letter grade, because the dominant accepted residual was left untouched.

## T1 modeling (why the gap stays 0.50)

All pre-execution / blast-radius controls — human prompt review, the two-layer env allowlist + controller-capability withholding, R-01 controller-source sealing, R-03 credential-name/provider-home policy, and R-07/R-25 per-child credential scoping — share one failure mode: none constrains **runtime exfiltration of the in-process active provider credential over open egress**. Per ARI's independence guardrail they are consolidated into ONE Partial posture (leakage 0.50), not multiplied. The four accepted residuals (C13–C16 = D-01…D-04) are Not Applied. So T1's gap is **0.50 in old, pivot, and final** — honestly holding the C cap.

## Verified control changes (implementation, not tests alone)
- **R-01** controller-source stock-closure sealing (SHA-256 digest of `.smithers/agents/*`, fail-closed at plan with TOCTOU re-check) — absent at baseline, present at final. Closes T2's controller-code-execution facet (T2 0.50→0.10).

With the independent materialization-destination block this makes T3 two-layer (0.50→0.04).
- **R-04** `data-governance.ts` (sensitivity, per-destination policy, digest-bound disclosure acknowledgement, OpenRouter model allowlist) — absent at baseline. T4 1.00→0.20.
- **R-10** adm-zip ^0.5.18→^0.6.0 + hardened archive parsing; **R-11** production dependency advisory gate (`check-production-dependency-advisories.mjs`, G-SECURITY release gate). Close T7's dependency/archive facets (T7 0.50→0.35, e=0.65) — the base-image/toolchain facet (R-12) and git submodule transport (R-20) remain deferred/open.
- **R-15** overflow-safe 100k-row eval-matrix cap; **R-16** egress-safe pricing fetch (HTTPS-only, credential/query rejection, localhost/metadata/private-CIDR rejection with resolved-IP re-check, redirect:'error', incremental byte cap). T9 0.20→0.04; T11 0.50→0.20.

## Accepted YOLO residuals — honest, Not Applied on T1 (pivot and final)
D-01 no OS sandbox/container (C13); D-02 no network-egress allowlist (C14); D-03 no command allowlist / in-run approval (C15); D-04 no mediated/proxied filesystem reads (C16). Pre-launch acknowledgement, controller policy, resource ceilings, credential minimization, and publication checks shrink blast radius but do not eliminate the underlying unrestricted-agent risk. Agents still run in YOLO/bypass-permissions with the in-process active provider credential over open egress; verified unchanged at final.

## Scope changes (old → pivot)
Added T11 (pricing SSRF); T4 rescored 0.50→1.00 (no governance control in baseline code); T2 broadened and rescored ~0.03→0.50 (open controller-source facet); T1 residuals expanded to four explicit Not-Applied controls; no retire/merge/severity-reweight otherwise.

Tests read, not executed; Modal-platform isolation, provider no-train/retention terms, and host network configuration are non-code Open Questions; T2/T7 use OR-of-facet single-posture modeling (T7 with a justified e=0.65); R-04 assurance depends on honest operator acknowledgement of a possibly target-supplied policy; R-18/R-28 at-rest source-reduction is noted but not credited as an independent T3 layer. The v1 defects (duplicate present independence groups in old T1/T3/T7, pivot T1, final T1/T3; arbitrary gaps in old T9, pivot T2/T3/T6/T7/T9, final T2/T3/T6/T7/T9/T11) are all corrected: every present control now has a distinct independence group, every gap equals its control-array leakage, and the pinned baseline reproduces exactly.
